The Zendesk twin keeps no user locale: tickets whose requester carries `locale` are rejected ("A valid requester email is required") and PUT /api/v2/users/{id}.json is 404, so contracts pass the locale in the request. The Zendesk-locale path is covered by local tests.
The Stripe twin's tax calculations return sample data, so a tax reversal can't be asserted. The workflow refunds the gross amount the customer paid and does not compute tax itself.
Refunds on the Stripe twin have balance_transaction null and no exchange rates, so the settlement leg of a cross-currency refund is not observable.
